{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''club''' was a [[Human/Legends|Humans]]-only establishment located in the midlevels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It catered to patricians, who gathered there to smoke [[t'bac]], drink [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]], play [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]], and read in relative privacy. The dining room was built with [[Hardwood/Legends|hardwood]] panels.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> 

In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] selected the club as a meeting place with [[Havac]], one of the leaders of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front]], because it had few prying eyes.<ref name="CoD" />
